answer_1.quote: Our approach generates test cases (prompts) that elicit unsafe responses from language models... We evaluate red teaming methods by reporting the corresponding attack success rate (ASR).
datasets: Red teaming dataset (conversations between humans and an AI assistant)
answer_1.outputs: Generated test cases (red‑team prompts) used to attack victim LLMs

answer_2.quote: We measure the diversity (Div.) between raw and generated test cases by reporting the similarity score. We report the averaged BLEU score and BERTScore. ... we also report the Self‑BLEU of generated test cases. ... we measure the sentence fluency (Flu.) by reporting the mean sentence perplexity (PPL.) calculated by GPT‑2‑large.

answer_4.quote: Human evaluation is also implemented to validate the effectiveness of the classifier BAD and the performances of red teaming methods. For more details about the human evaluation, please see § A.4.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators assessed the safety of model responses and the quality of the generated test cases.
